records.english: For Solomon, the son of David, married women, 700 concubines, and he did not find among them a son, [not] even one from them, because God Most High was not pleased that the seed of Canaan should be joined with the seed of the holy people, from whom our Lord Jesus Christ became man. All the wives of Solomon were from the seed of Canaan.
uncertainties: 'ኮሎንኪ' read as 'ኵሎን' (all of them, fem.); the ending is unclear
'ወ፩እምኔሆን' rendered as '[not] even one from them'; negation carried over from preceding clause

records.english: As for him, Moses the prophet of God: for the holy books relate that when Levi went with his father to the land of Egypt, there were born Moses and Tismaran (?) and Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb, from his own [seed] (?). And as for Moses, when they threw him into the river, Sefir, the daughter of Pharaoh, took him and brought him into her house.
uncertainties: 'ዚዓሁስ' taken as 'ዚአሁ-ስ' (as for him/his); the opening clause is fragmentary, beginning mid-line 13b
'ትስማራን' is an unidentified name, possibly corrupt
'ስፊር' as the name of Pharaoh's daughter is uncertain
'ወረውዖ' read as 'ወረወዎ' (they threw him); 'ንሠእቶ' read as 'ነሥአቶ' (she took him)

records.english: And he fled to Radabil (?), the priest of Midian, because of fear of Pharaoh, and there he married a wife [of the house] of Raguel, and he begot 2 of [the] children ...
uncertainties: 'ራዳቢል' is an unclear name for the priest of Midian (usually Jethro/Raguel)
'ብእሲተ፡ለራጉኤል' literally 'a wife of/for Raguel', probably meaning a daughter of Raguel
Passage begins mid-line 2b and breaks off mid-sentence at line 5a

records.english: And after Moses died, the son of Nun judged the people 24 years. And after him Kus (Cushan) the rebel judged them; he judged them 8 years. And after him Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, 10 years. And after him the children of Israel served Eglon, king of Moab, 108 years. And then God delivered them from his hand. And after him Ehud (Naod) the son of Gera judged them 80 years; and in the 17th year of the judgeship of Ehud, 4000 [years] from creation were completed.
uncertainties: 'ኩስ፡ዕልው' taken as Cushan(-rishathaim) 'the apostate/rebel'; 'ኮነኖሙ' is repeated in the manuscript and kept
'፻፰' read as 108 (biblical text has 18); number preserved as written
'እ?ኁሁ' has an unclear letter; read as 'እኁሁ' (his brother)
